mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO drops > 2% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected cut in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances following an unexpected FEDFUNDS cut.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises and PAYEMS falls.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a rise in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST and GDPC1 both rise.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a higher-than-expected increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a more aggressive stance by the Fed, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases more than expected.
